scripts.perf: npm run perf:build && node perf/.out/run.js grid
scripts.perf:mission: npm run perf:build && node perf/.out/run.js mission
scripts.perf:save: npm run perf:build && node perf/.out/run.js grid --out perf/baselines/local.json
scripts.perf:compare: npm run perf:build && node perf/.out/run.js grid --out perf/.out/current.json && node perf/compare.mjs perf/baselines/local.json perf/.out/current.json
scripts.perf:profile: npm run perf:build && node --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-dir=perf/.prof perf/.out/run.js grid
scripts.perf:config: vite build --ssr perf/config.js --outDir perf/.out --logLevel error && node perf/.out/config.js
scripts.perf:map: vite build --sourcemap hidden --logLevel error && echo 'map written to dist/assets/'
scripts.perf:device: npm run perf:profile && npm run perf:map && node perf/profile.mjs perf/.prof perf/traces --map dist/assets
